text:
Hiro: uploaded a micro-proto for a compact timeline scrubber that supports touch-drag, arrow-key micro-steps, and snap-to-snapshot. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact/scrubber-proto

Marta: nice! two immediate asks: 1) visual affordance for live vs preview mode, 2) how touch haptics/long-press behave on mobile.

Leah: proposal: while dragging show a translucent overlay "Previewing: v2026-03-10" and a tiny live-dot for current traffic position. On release no change until user taps "Apply".

Sam: implementation: debounce preview requests to 200ms while scrubbing; fetch snapshot metadata only for snap points, not every px. cache per session.

Alex (A11y): keyboard: left/right move 1% of timeline, Shift+arrow jump to next snapshot marker. Home/End to jump start/end. When focus lands on snapshot announce: "Snapshot March 10 2026, by Hiro, canary 10%". Also ensure scrubbing can be done without pointer by exposing a list view of snapshots.

Hiro: mobile note: long-press on Android could be the expand label, but iOS long-press triggers system menu. fallback: tap-and-hold opens our preview on iOS, but with shorter hold threshold and preventDefault on touchstart. QA needed.

Marta: microcopy for the apply control: options: "Apply snapshot", "Rollback to this version", "Activate snapshot". Leaning toward "Apply snapshot" (less scary).

Leah: +1 to "Apply snapshot". Add secondary "Compare" CTA that opens a quick diff.

Alex (A11y): announcements: use a polite live region for non-blocking previews: "Previewing snapshot March 10". For the apply action, focus should move to a confirmation region with an assertive announcement: "Snapshot applied" and then a small undo toast with 20s timer. Ensure aria-live and aria-atomic set appropriately.

Sam: undo flow note: backend creates a reversible job for 20s window. UI should reflect optimistic apply then reconcile if job fails.

Hiro: visual compactness: scrubber has three zoom tiers: condensed (no markers), standard (markers collapsed), expanded (markers with labels). On condensed, show an affordance to expand.

Marta: accessibility/contrast: preview pill needs 4.5:1 contrast in both dark and light. Leah can you run tokens against both themes?

Leah: will run checks and post updated figma tokens.

design-bot: preview deployed for feat/compact-scrubber -> https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-scrubber (expires in 48h)

Hiro: i'll add a tiny haptic suggestion for mobile: light tick on snap points and stronger buzz on apply. tag @Sam for feasibility.

Sam: haptics look doable on supported devices. we'll gate by platform capability and provide a no-haptics fallback.

Alex (A11y): final reminder: include a text-only fallback for the scrubber (list of snapshots) reachable from keyboard and SR users. call out shortcut keys in the help menu.

Marta: great notes. i'll update the prototype with preview pill copy "Previewing snapshot" and button copy "Apply snapshot". Back in a couple hours. :sparkles:
